<translate>
<!--T:6-->
'''Mummy''' is one of [[Special:MyLanguage/Fortuneteller Baba|Fortuneteller Baba]]'s fighters, a huge bandaged brawler and the toughest of her four contenders. He fights in [[Special:MyLanguage/Fortuneteller Baba's Tournament|Fortuneteller Baba's Tournament]] at [[Special:MyLanguage/Fortuneteller Baba's Palace|Baba's Palace]] on [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]], and is one of Baba's fighters in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Classic Saga|Classic Saga]].
</translate>

<translate>
== In the tournament == <!--T:7-->

<!--T:8-->
The Mummy is one of the four contenders of Fortuneteller Baba's Tournament, together with [[Special:MyLanguage/Fangs the Vampire|Fangs the Vampire]], the [[Special:MyLanguage/Invisible Man|Invisible Man]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Akkuman|Akkuman]]. The contenders come in random order and get 10% stronger for every round already played; after them come the [[Special:MyLanguage/Masked Warrior|Masked Warrior]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Kid Goku|Kid Goku]]. His default stats for the first round are:
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:14-->
Bouts end at knockout, so nobody dies. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Tournaments|Tournaments]] for how bouts work.
</translate>

<translate>
== Behavior and abilities == <!--T:15-->

<!--T:16-->
The Mummy is about one and a half times the height of a player. He doesn't fly and has no ki attacks: he fights with melee only, so his ki damage goes unused. In the tournament he fights on the '''Novice''' AI tier (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas#Enemy AI tiers|enemy AI tiers]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:17-->

<!--T:18-->
The [[Special:MyLanguage/Classic Saga|Classic Saga]] quest '''Baba's Fighters: The Mummy''' (quest 26) has you defeat him at Fortuneteller Baba's Palace.
</translate>
